sam: Proposal: introduce a "stream grace" window to allow long-running streaming responses to be deprioritized after a configurable period so we can admit short, latency-sensitive requests. sketch of problem and benefits...

mira: Wait — deprioritize how? abort the stream or slow it? :thinking_face:

sam: idea is to move stream to a low-priority queue, preempt GPU slots, and keep a small in-memory marker so stream can be resumed if capacity frees (or client reconnects). Not full resume-token protocol, more like "soft deprioritize" with short grace.

kevin: Clients will notice partial responses. What's the API contract? Need explicit signal so SDKs can surface it.

olivia: Heuristic: only deprioritize streams > X seconds OR estimated remaining tokens > Y and when queue latency for short requests > SLO threshold.

sam: config example:
```
edge.stream_grace:
  enable: true
  grace_seconds: 8
  short_request_threshold_ms: 200
  deprioritize_when_queue_len_gt: 20
```

jen: Important: we must not do this for paths that may trigger side-effects (function calls/webhooks). Would prefer to only apply to pure text generation endpoints unless `idempotency-key` present.

infra-bot: current edge slot limit per node = 64 streams. Observed spikes during rolling-model-load increase queue depth 3x.

mira: For client-visible behavior: emit a trailer frame `event: stream_deprioritized` and include `estimated_resume_hint` and optional `resume_token` if we can afford it.

kevin: Resume-token is tricky and close to existing resume work. Can we instead return `retry_after_ms` and let client re-open a fresh request with prefix caching to avoid re-attending earlier tokens?

olivia: Good point — prefix/KV cache on the gateway can make fresh reconnect cheap. Recommend favoring reconnect+cache over complex stateful resume.

sam: Also: fallback policy — if deprioritized stream later becomes high-priority (user action), proxied route can bump it back up if capacity exists.

jen: Rollout plan: (1) feature-flag in edge, (2) telemetry: per-request latency buckets, deprioritized-count, resume-success-rate, client-observed partials, (3) small canary on Dedicated, (4) opt-in for hosted beta.

mira: Metrics we need in Console: % requests that were deprioritized and their error/retry churn, tail latency improvement for short requests.

kevin: We must update SDKs to surface `stream_deprioritized` event and a recommended UX pattern.

sam: Open questions: exact semantics for function-calling, hedging interaction, cost accounting for partial tokens, and billing when we deprioritize.

olivia: For billing, suggest bill only tokens delivered; if client reconnects and gateway serves cached prefix, we avoid double-counting.

jen: Action items: sam to do 1-week spike to implement a prototype in edge with config above; olivia to draft heuristics and perf test plan; kevin/mira to write SDK UX and API signaling; jen to scope telemetry. We'll write RFC after spike.

sam: I'll drop a link to the spike branch and include some microbench numbers once I have them. Thanks everyone :rocket:
